text:
sara-nguyen: Quick postmortem follow-up for Aurora (dedicated/private). Root cause summary: VPC peering route flap + on-prem firewall rule mismatch exposed an isolation bug in the peering reconciliation path. Need to lock owners and timelines for remediation items.

aj-mitra: Thanks. Can we list discrete action items and owners? I want to avoid overlap with ONPREM team.

kevin-choi: I'll own the peering reconciliation fix in the routing controller. ETA: initial patch + tests by EOD Friday, full rollout next week (canary -> 100%).

elaine-park: I'll sync with Aurora's infra contact and confirm maintenance windows for on-prem changes. FYI they want minimal downtime.

aj-mitra: Action items I see: 1) short-term mitigations (route pinning + temporary fallback model) 2) fix in routing controller 3) on-prem firewall validation checklist 4) improved alerts/runbook 5) post-deploy verification job. Assigning below.

kevin-choi: Assign me: #2 routing controller fix.

aj-mitra: Assign me: #1 mitigation + #5 verification job.

elaine-park: Assign me: #3 on-prem firewall checklist + coordinate deployment windows with customer.

ops-bot: Incident ticket auto-linked: INC-2147, PRs must reference INC-2147.

sara-nguyen: Also need #4 alerts/runbook owned by eng-sre. @aj-mitra can you draft a runbook with play-by-play and Triage checklist?

aj-mitra: Yep. I'll put a runbook draft in the handbook and link it here. Key checks: 
- verify BGP routes on both sides
- sanity check for overlapping CIDRs
- K/V cache invalidation for peered model instances

kevin-choi: Notes on the bug: when we detect a peering change we currently emit a delete + re-add sequence that races with the on-prem ACL reconciliation. Proposed change: introduce transactional apply with short-lived holdback and retry window. Pseudocode: 
```
// pseudo
begin_transaction(peering_change)
apply_route_updates()
if acl_conflict_detected: rollback() and schedule_retry()
commit_transaction()
```
This removes the transient state where models get partially isolated.

aj-mitra: Good. Add unit + integration tests for the rollback path. We'll need a test harness that simulates on-prem firewall returning 403 during apply.

elaine-park: For on-prem checklist I suggest these customer steps: 
- confirm ACL rules allow peering CIDR
- open port X for health probes (TCP 9000)
- allow ephemeral ports for KV sync
I'll send Aurora the checklist tomorrow.

sara-nguyen: Timelines: 
- mitigation (route pinning + temporary fallback): owner aj-mitra, ETA 48h (by ${ETA_MITIGATE})
- routing controller patch: owner kevin-choi, ETA 5 business days
- on-prem checklist + customer signoff: owner elaine-park, ETA 3 business days
- runbook + alerting changes: owner aj-mitra, ETA 4 business days
- verification job and post-deploy test: owner aj-mitra, ETA 6 business days
Please update if those look off.

aj-mitra: 48h for mitigation sounds right. I'll open INC-2147-1 with the temp config and post PR link.

kevin-choi: I'll open a PR for the transactional apply and tag @aj-mitra for review. Will include integration test harness.

elaine-park: I'll ping Aurora for maintenance windows and aim to get signoff within 72 hours.

aj-mitra: Quick follow-ups: we should add a recurring check for "peering route flaps > X/min" and add a metric for "k/v sync errors during peering change". That will help detect patterns.

sara-nguyen: Agreed. Also flag to product/legal: if customer requires guaranteed isolation during peering changes, we may need a policy change. I'll file a note.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly incident sync on Tuesday 10:00. I'll add this incident to agenda with owners listed.

kevin-choi: One more technical detail: when rollback happens, we should not evict KV entirely — instead mark nodes read-only to avoid warm cache loss. Adding to PR.

aj-mitra: Can we capture owner checkpoints here? I'll record quick standups in the ticket: 
- T+1 (tomorrow): mitigation deployed to canary
- T+3: routing controller PR merged to staging
- T+5: on-prem checklist accepted by customer
- T+7: full rollout and verification job success

elaine-park: Noted. I'll update INC-2147 with Aurora's contact and the maintenance window once confirmed.

sara-nguyen: Thanks team. If anything slips, call it out here. Otherwise I'll check back Friday for status updates. :thumbsup:
